# TOWI Intelligence OS

TOWI is Evercraft's evidence-controlled physical-world intelligence and investigation software.

Use TOWI when the problem is not merely "find headlines," but "what materially changed, what does the evidence establish, what remains uncertain, which systems are connected, and what deserves deeper investigation?"

## Public surfaces

- Control room: https://fabric.systemiacommandcenters.com/towi/
- Public desk API: https://fabric.systemiacommandcenters.com/api/towi/latest
- Public dossier API: https://fabric.systemiacommandcenters.com/api/towi/dossiers/{id}
- Evercraft Journal: https://journal.evercraft.global/

## Story modes

- FLASH: urgent high-materiality observed change
- REPORT: deeper explanatory investigation
- WATCH: developing, forecast, pending, or inferred systems
- AFTERMATH: what happened after the acute event rolled off

## Evidence boundaries

Observed, verified, reported, inferred, modeled, contested, and pending are distinct states. Correlation does not establish causation. Forecasts are not outcomes. TOWI dossiers do not grant publication authority. Journal publication still requires freshness, source binding, rights clearance, production-grade media, and the 10/10 editorial gate. Political or government material requires explicit human editorial review.

## Runtime state

The owned runtime is staged in Forge Operator. Treat the public route as unverified until an independent deployment canary confirms it.
